name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Dymer toll 11; Russian ships hit off Libya
summary: Dymer strike death toll reaches 11; Ukraine says it sank a Russian corvette off Libya; strikes on Russian refineries
state: Ukrainian authorities said the Russian strike on Dymer, Kyiv region, on 22 Nov killed 11 people after rescuers found another body; Ukrainian drones hit refineries in Perm and Rostov regions on 23 Nov (Moscow Times). Zelensky said on 23 Nov Ukraine sank the corvette Merkury at Benghazi port in Libya with naval drones; the UN mission in Libya called for an investigation (Al Jazeera). An overnight barrage of 110 missiles and over 400 drones on 20 Nov killed at least eight, Zelensky said (CBS News). Repeated mass-casualty strikes and the war's widening reach keep the Alert.
for_you: Civilians across Ukraine face missile and drone strikes and power cuts. The FCDO advises against all travel to Ukraine; follow official guidance. Energy and grain markets remain sensitive to strikes on refineries, ports and shipping, including in the Baltic and Mediterranean.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty strikes (Dymer, 11 killed 22 Nov) and widening reach with attacks on Russian ships off Libya
